name: Desirea Kennedy 210 SW Century Dr

nadir.desc: The property is a six-story building in a large S-shape|Parking lots wrap the entire perimeter of the structure, with covered parking to the rear of the property|A construction site is located directly in front of the main entrance|Other properties and structures surround the property|The parking lot has small segments of soil, bushes, and trees|Roadways are visible throughout and around the property.

alpha.desc: The front of the property shows the main entrance and the construction site|Parking lots face the building on all sides|Small areas of landscape are visible throughout the parking lot|Windows and balconies are visible on all floors and all sides of the building.

bravo.desc: The left side of the property is flanked by other buildings and roadways|The exterior of the building is covered with windows and balconies.

charlie.desc: The rear of the property shows a parking lot on all sides with windows uniformly on each floor and covering the entire facade|Covered parking is visible to the rear of the building.

delta.desc: The right side of the property shows the building surrounded by parking lots|Windows and small balconies are visible on each floor along the entire facade|Trees and smaller vegetation are located in pockets within the parking lot.

considerations: All sides of the building and property are accessible through streets and parking lots. Parking lots surround the building on all sides and provide space for vehicle movement and potential staging. The construction site in front of the main entrance may affect access to the primary entry. Small landscaped areas are present within the parking lots but do not significantly impact movement around the building.
clarifications: What type of emergency measures are in place within the building, beyond what is dictated by federal and state laws? Where are all stairwells and elevators located within the building? Are there any gates or barriers controlling access to the parking areas? Is there designated emergency vehicle access or fire lanes around the building? Are there multiple points of entry into the building itself?
